queries: AI data center tenant missed payments default neocloud 2026

sources_considered.why: Tracker of GPU and data center credit stress events, updated October 17, 2026. It shows whether any data center tenant had failed to pay.
Reports bond-price stress, not a tenant failing to pay. Not needed to test the antecedent.
Commentary on tenant risk, not a payment failure.

receipt.public_excerpt: No neocloud has publicly defaulted on a GPU-backed loan, and we found no public record of a GPU-backed loan being foreclosed and its GPUs auctioned as of October 2026.

evidence_items.explanation: As of October 2026 the tracker records no neocloud default and no data center tenant failing to pay in 2026. The 2026 entries are a cloud-compute buyer's bankruptcy and lease walkaways that were not defaults. So the antecedent had not happened by the time of the post.

unresolved_gaps: No public record found of an AI data center tenant failing to pay its lease or capacity obligations before the evaluation date.

Character.AI's October 2026 Chapter 11 involves a buyer of cloud compute with $50–100M in estimated liabilities, not a data-center tenant backing bond-financed collateral. Under the reading here it does not meet the antecedent.
The tracker is a secondary source and could miss private or unreported payment failures.
